description: This file defines the RegistrationEventProcessorFactory class responsible for creating instances of registration event processors based on event types within the OrangeHRM system. It specifically handles registration events related to active and inactive employee counts.

classes.name: RegistrationEventProcessorFactory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for instantiating appropriate registration event processor objects based on event type.

methods.name: getRegistrationEventProcessor
methods.description: Returns an instance of a registration event processor corresponding to the provided event type. Throws InvalidArgumentException if the event type is unrecognized.
